tool.name: bcftools @EXECUTABLE@
tool.description: Merge multiple VCF/BCF files from non-overlapping sample sets to create one multi-sample file
tool.command:
@PREPARE_INPUT_FILES@ #set $section = $sec_restrict @PREPARE_REGIONS_FILE@
bcftools @EXECUTABLE@
## Header section #set $section = $sec_header ${section.print_header} #if $section.use_header: --use-header '${section.use_header}' #end if @NO_VERSION@
## Merge section #set $section = $sec_merge ${section.force_samples} ${section.force_single} ${section.missing_to_ref}
#if str($section.gvcf.gvcf_merge) == "without_ref": --gvcf - #elif str($section.gvcf.gvcf_merge) == "with_ref": --gvcf '${section.gvcf.ref_file}' #end if
#if str($section.info_rules.info_rules_selector) == "none": --info-rules '-' #elif str($section.info_rules.info_rules_selector) == "custom": #set $rules_list = [] #for $r in $section.info_rules.rules: #set $tags = str($r.tag).strip().split(',') #for $t in $tags: #if $t.strip(): #silent $rules_list.append($t.strip() + ':' + str($r.method)) #end if #end for #end for #if $rules_list: --info-rules '#echo ",".join($rules_list)#' #end if #end if
#if $section.local_alleles > 0: --local-alleles ${section.local_alleles} #end if
#if $section.merge: #if str($section.unobserved) != "none": --merge '${section.merge},${section.unobserved}' #else: --merge '${section.merge}' #end if #elif str($section.unobserved) != "none": --merge 'both,${section.unobserved}' #end if
#if $section.missing_rules: --missing-rules '${section.missing_rules}' #end if
## Restrict section #set $section = $sec_restrict @APPLY_FILTERS@
#if $section.filter_logic: --filter-logic '$section.filter_logic' #end if
@REGIONS@
@OUTPUT_TYPE@ @THREADS@
## Primary Input/Outputs @INPUT_FILES@ > '$output_file'

param.name: merge
param.label: Merge multiallelic records
param.help: Controls what types of multiallelic records can be created (-m)

param.name: unobserved
param.label: Drop unobserved alleles
param.help: Remove the unobserved allele <*> or <NON_REF> (* or **)

param.name: missing_to_ref
param.label: Assume genotypes at missing sites are 0/0

param.name: info_rules_selector
param.label: Rules for merging INFO fields
param.help: Rules for merging INFO fields or '-' to turn off the default [DP:sum,DP4:sum] (-i, --info-rules)

param.name: tag
param.label: INFO tag(s)
param.help: Name of the INFO tag, e.g. DP, TR, AC. Multiple tags using the same method can be separated with commas (e.g. TR,TA,TG).

param.name: method
param.label: Merge Method
param.help: Method used to combine values across files

param.name: missing_rules
param.label: Missing Rules
param.help: Rules for replacing missing values in numeric vectors (.,0,max) when unknown allele is not present (-M)

param.name: local_alleles
param.label: Local Alleles limit
param.help: If more than INT alt alleles are encountered, drop FMT/PL and output LAA+LPL instead; 0=unlimited (-L)

param.name: force_single
param.label: Force Single
param.help: Run even if only one file is given on input

param.name: filter_logic
param.label: Filter Logic
param.help: Remove filters if some input is PASS ('x'), or apply all filters ('+') (-F)
param.option: Remove filters if some input is PASS (x)

param.name: print_header
param.label: Print Header
param.help: Print only the merged header and exit

tool.help:
===================================== bcftools @EXECUTABLE@ =====================================
Merge multiple VCF/BCF files from non-overlapping sample sets to create one multi-sample file.
Note that only records from different files can be merged, never from the same file. For "vertical" merge take a look at bcftools concat or bcftools norm -m instead.
Multiallelic record merging (``-m``) ------------------------------------ Controls what types of multiallelic records can be created when the same site appears in multiple files: * **none**: No new multiallelic records are created; separate records are output instead. * **snps**: Allow multiallelic SNP records. * **indels**: Allow multiallelic indel records. * **both**: Both SNP and indel records can be multiallelic (default). * **snp-ins-del**: Allow multiallelic SNVs, insertions, and deletions, but do not mix these types. * **all**: Allow any variant records to be merged together (e.g. SNVs with indels). * **exact**: Allow multiallelic records only when REF and ALT alleles match exactly. * **id**: Merge records matching on the ``ID`` column. * **Drop unobserved alleles (``*`` or ``**``)**: Remove unobserved placeholder alleles (``<*>`` or ``<NON_REF>``) from variant sites (``*``) or from all sites (``**``).
gVCF Merging (``-g``) ---------------------
Merges non-variant block records produced by haplotype callers (e.g. GATK HaplotypeCaller or DeepVariant) where an ``INFO/END`` tag is present. .. note:: Using ``--gvcf`` automatically activates the following default rules: * **INFO rules:** ``-i QS:sum,MinDP:min,I16:sum,IDV:max,IMF:max`` * **Missing rules:** ``-M PL:max,AD:0``
Merging and Missing Rules (``-i`` and ``-M``) ---------------------------------------------
* **Info rules (``-i TAG:METHOD``):** Defines how to combine values of an INFO field across files. Supported methods: * ``sum``: Sum numeric values. * ``avg``: Average numeric values. * ``min``: Keep the minimum numeric value. * ``max``: Keep the maximum numeric value. * ``join``: Concatenate values (strings or lists). * ``-``: Turn off default rules (by default ``DP:sum,DP4:sum`` are applied). * **Missing rules (``-M TAG:METHOD``):** Defines replacement values for numeric vector tags when an allele is not observed in a sample (``.`` for missing, ``0`` or constant number, or ``max``).
@REGIONS_HELP@
@BCFTOOLS_MANPAGE@#@EXECUTABLE@
@BCFTOOLS_HOWTOS@
